questions.q: Where does an admin configure which tabs appear by default in a Lightning app, and in what order?
options: The Navigation Items step of that app in App Manager
The Object Manager's Page Layouts page
Each user's individual profile
The Lightning App Builder's Record Detail component
questions.explain: Navigation Items is the App Manager wizard step with Available Items and Selected Items columns, where the admin sets the default tab set and order.

questions.q: Why can the Sales app and the Product Management app show completely different tab sets in the same org?
options: Because they're separate Salesforce orgs under the hood
Because each app has its own independent Navigation Items configuration, even though they share the same underlying data model
Because only one app can be active in an org at a time
Because custom objects can only appear in one app ever
questions.explain: Each app's Navigation Items is configured separately, so two apps in the same org with the same data can present completely different default navigation.

questions.q: What is a user NOT able to do when personalizing their own navigation bar?
options: Add items from their favorites
Drag existing items to reorder them
Rename or remove the default items an admin specified for the app
Remove an item they personally added
questions.explain: The lesson states users can reorder and add items, and remove what they personally added, but cannot rename or remove the admin's default items.

questions.q: What happens to a user's ability to personalize their navigation bar once it holds more than 50 items?
options: Nothing changes — there is no limit
The bar automatically resets to the admin default
Users can no longer personalize the navigation bar at all
Only the admin can add new items past 50, but users can still remove them
questions.explain: The lesson notes that users lose the ability to personalize their navigation bar once it contains more than 50 items.

questions.q: On the Navigation Items step, why does the order of items in "Selected Items" matter?
options: It doesn't matter — Salesforce always alphabetizes tabs for display
It determines the left-to-right render order of tabs in the actual navigation bar
It only affects the order shown in Setup, not what users see
It controls field-level security for each object
questions.explain: Items in Selected Items render as tabs left to right in exactly the sequence they're listed in that column.
